title: Answer: space, time's arrow, the quantum, gravity and selves, if the base reaches them

statements.text: Everything else is meant to emerge from the one base: space and its dimension, time's arrow, relativity, spin, light, the quantum, gravity and selves. Each has to come out of the base, or the base is wrong. Vibe does not yet show that all of them do. Some are measured on the working rule, such as light the same in every direction on the husk, Bell violation and the arrow of time, and others are partial, stand-ins or open.
